_why: `stage()` measured nothing while `h_mad_assemble_audit` held seven size guards one file over, so a ~690 KB 6a-prime prompt was written, said STAGED, and was then refused by the surface -- read as "6a-prime failed" rather than "the prompt was never delivered". Each mutation carries its own `test` key: a battery that scores ALL_CAUGHT while one mutation bit nothing has happened twice in this file's history, and only the per-mutation re-score separates them.

mutations.name: the-size-gate-never-fires
mutations._mechanism: The state before this change: a prompt no surface accepts is written to disk and reported STAGED. The operator dispatches it and reads the refusal as a failed review.

mutations.name: the-gate-measures-the-body-before-the-contract-prepend
mutations._mechanism: The placement, isolated from the gate's existence. Discounting the contract's ~800 chars passes a prompt that is deliverable only until the contract is added -- the surface then refuses it, which is the original defect with a size check bolted on that cannot see the last thing written.
mutations.replace: oversize, limit, headroom = _size_gate(len(body) - (len(contract_head) if report_file is not None else 0))

mutations.name: the-oversize-prompt-is-written-anyway
mutations._mechanism: Halting but leaving the file is worse than not halting: the next copy-pasted dispatch line finds a prompt on disk and sends it. The refusal and the absent file are two claims, and a test asserting only the token would pass here.

mutations.name: the-halt-does-not-name-its-escape-hatch
mutations._mechanism: A halt whose remedy is unstated is a wall. The operator's only visible options become shrinking the design by hand or abandoning 6a-prime, and --vh-tail -- which exists for exactly this -- goes unused.
mutations.find: "Re-run with --vh-tail N to inline only the last N Version History "

mutations.name: vh-tail-is-parsed-but-never-reaches-stage
mutations._mechanism: The flag appears in --help, argparse accepts it, and it silently does nothing -- the shape of failure where a documented remedy looks implemented. The prompt comes back the same size and the operator concludes the design is irreducible.

mutations.name: the-trim-keeps-every-entry
mutations._mechanism: The delegation itself. Returning the text untouched makes --vh-tail inert at the other end from the wiring mutation above; both produce an unchanged prompt, so each needs its own kill.
